mapper.select: SELECT OPERATION_KEY,ACTOR_ID,REQUEST_KEY,REQUEST_KIND,FINGERPRINT_VERSION,REQUEST_FINGERPRINT,AUTH_SCOPE,OUTCOME,CHILD_COUNT,CHILD_MANIFEST_HASH,CREATE_TIME,ACCEPTED_AT FROM SMT_AUTH_REQUEST_INTAKE WHERE ACTOR_ID=#{actorId} AND REQUEST_KEY=#{requestKey}
SELECT ID,PARK_ID,SOURCE_ID,SOURCE_TYPE,ACTION,IDEMPOTENCY_KEY,PAYLOAD_FINGERPRINT,EXPECTED_COUNT FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH WHERE SOURCE_ID=#{operationKey} ORDER BY PARK_ID,ID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT B.ID FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH B WHERE B.SOURCE_ID=#{operationKey} AND ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE S WHERE S.BATCH_ID=B.ID AND S.PARK_ID=B.PARK_ID AND S.OPERATION_KEY=#{operationKey}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE S WHERE S.BATCH_ID=B.ID AND (S.PARK_ID!=B.PARK_ID OR S.OPERATION_KEY!=#{operationKey}))) UNION ALL SELECT S.BATCH_ID FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE S WHERE S.OPERATION_KEY=#{operationKey} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH B WHERE B.ID=S.BATCH_ID AND B.PARK_ID=S.PARK_ID AND B.SOURCE_ID=#{operationKey}) )
